deconstruct_text:
Let's imagine you're an election officer verifying COMELEC ballot box IDs. The original is PH-2026-8941-X, but the printed list shows PH-2026-8491-X. One slip could mix up precinct results—compare carefully.

Write them one on top of the other: Original: PH-2026-8941-X, Copy: PH-2026-8491-X. Now compare each position. The first eight characters (PH-2026-) are identical. Then you see: position 9: 9 vs 4 — different; position 10: 4 vs 9 — different; the rest match.

So exactly two characters differ. Here's the mental trick: Pag may swap, isipin mo agad, 'Dalawa ang difference!' Hindi lang isa. Bawat karakter na nagbago ay hiwalay na bilang. Parang dalawang pasahero na nagpalit ng upuan—dalawang upuan ang may bagong laman.
